property_summary: After any sequence of calls, the sum of all user balances equals the total Ether sent to the contract minus the total Ether withdrawn; the buggy addToBalance resets the balance before adding, so the sum of balances undercounts total deposits.
change_summary: Insert a line that resets the caller's balance to 0 before the normal addition, causing the final balance to be just msg.value instead of the sum.
